data_quality_controls: Do not average unsynchronized CoinMarketCap price/volume observations.
Do not average Liqwall and TradRadar open interest; normalize venue and contract coverage first.
Do not interpret account long/short ratios as notional exposure.
Do not annualize funding without stating simple-versus-compounded convention.
Do not treat modelled liquidation heatmaps as actual exchange position levels.
ETF flows are daily net creations/redemptions for the stated five-fund scope; do not conflate with AUM or cumulative holdings.
No raw API payloads or cryptographic payload hashes were captured in this web-search snapshot; these records are not yet production feature-store data.
